description: This file defines the PlaceholderGenerator class in Drupal, responsible for converting render arrays into placeholders with cache management and markup generation.

classes.name: PlaceholderGenerator
classes.description: Implements placeholder creation for render arrays, managing cache dependencies and generating placeholder markup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PlaceholderGenerator with cache context manager and renderer configuration.

methods.name: canCreatePlaceholder
methods.description: Determines if a placeholder can be created for a given render element based on lazy builder presence and placeholder creation flag.

methods.name: shouldAutomaticallyPlaceholder
methods.description: Decides if a render element should be auto-placeholdered based on cache max-age, contexts, and tags.

methods.name: createPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates a placeholder render array with cache metadata and markup, including a unique token.

methods.name: createPlaceholderTag
methods.description: Generates an HTML tag with given attributes for placeholder markup.
